name: Layout Clone
description: Copy footprint placement between repeated circuits using connectivity matching, anchors and a preview. English and Turkish UI.
description_full: Replicate one footprint layout across multiple repeated circuits. Select source and target groups directly in the PCB Editor, match parts using pad connectivity, inspect mappings and apply anchor-relative positions and angles. Includes rotation, centre-only reflection and English/Turkish language switching (English by default). Uses the KiCad IPC API and native undo. Does not copy or reroute tracks, vias or zones; run DRC after placement. This testing release targets Windows / KiCad 10.0 and blocks writes when the schematic editor is open because of reported KiCad IPC transaction crashes. See the project README for installation, limitations and troubleshooting.
